Rather than reacting to a single session's expectations reset, the fundamental test for a long-term holding is whether $NVDA executes the Q4 FY25 Blackwell volume ramp on schedule and stabilizes gross margins in the mid-70% range [E7, E8].

Resolving this binary risk requires engaging a credible successor auditor, completing the Special Committee review, and securing exchange and lender extensions [E4, E7, E9].

This is research, not investment advice.
